subject: Proposal: hosted API commit advance and throttle migration plan
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@clarityai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: hosted API commit advance and throttle migration plan

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I pulled together a short proposal to advance ClarityAI's committed hosted API capacity ahead of the Jan renewal so you have the burst headroom for the model expansion you're shipping in Q1. High-level summary below:

- Current: Hosted monthly commit = 1.5M tokens, soft burst up to 3M with fair-rate gating.
- Proposal: Move to a 3.5M monthly commit (12-month term) with a 5M burst pocket and a staggered rate ceiling that reduces unit cost by ~18% after month 3.

Operational ask: to avoid runtime throttling during the migration window we recommend a two-week throttle migration where we increase prefix cache allocation and enable a dedicated KV cache lane for your primary project. That requires a brief operational maintenance window (non-disruptive) and an updated SOW for staffing.

I've attached a draft SOW and the usage export from October that informed the sizing. If you can confirm procurement timelines (procurement@clarityai.com) and whether you need invoicing on a calendar-month cadence vs. net-30, I’ll loop in our finance/ops lead.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the draft SOW and rate matrix (attached)
2) Procurement confirms PO timing and invoice cadence
3) Karthik and I run an ops pre-check (two business days) and schedule the migration window

Would Wednesday 11/24 at 10am PT work for a quick alignment call?

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: ClarityAI_SOW_v2.pdf, clarityai_usage_October2026.csv, redwood_rate_matrix_Q4.xlsx

From: Emma Chen <emma@clarityai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: hosted API commit advance and throttle migration plan

Lauren —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. The proposal looks close to what we discussed. A couple quick clarifying points from our side before we loop procurement:

- Are the burst pockets pre-provisioned capacity (reserved) or billed as overage at a lower unit rate? We need to know for our forecasting.
- Will the staggered rate kick in automatically or is it tied to monthly spend thresholds?
- Procurement prefers invoices on calendar-month cadence. Net-30 would be a challenge for our current finance month close.

We can do Wed 11/24 10am PT for the call. I’ll invite procurement and our infra lead (cc'd on my side).

—Emma
Emma Chen
Head of Platform, ClarityAI
emma@clarityai.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Emma Chen <emma@clarityai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: hosted API commit advance and throttle migration plan

Emma / Lauren —

Quick ops notes so the call can be productive:

1) Burst pocket: it's reserved capacity that we earmark for your org for the contract period. We don't pre-spin GPUs; instead we reserve a portion of shared capacity and guarantee a soft floor. Overages beyond the 5M burst pocket would be billed as overage at the pre-agreed overage rate in the sheet.

2) Staggered rate: the reduced unit cost after month 3 is automatic and based on rolling monthly consumption hitting the thresholds in redwood_rate_matrix_Q4.xlsx. We'll enumerate the thresholds on the call so finance can model it.

3) Migration ops: suggested maintenance window is low-risk (no model restart) — changelog includes KV cache lane prep, tuning batcher high-water mark, and pre-loading hot prefixes. Plan takes ~90 minutes plus a 4-hour monitoring window.

Marissa — can you confirm we have the SRE shift for the week of Dec 6 if ClarityAI signs? Also Lauren — for invoicing: we can accept calendar-month cadence; finance will generate a pro-forma invoice to match.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Chen <emma@clarityai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clarityai.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: hosted API commit advance and throttle migration plan

Thanks Karthik — that answers our questions. Procurement is okay with a calendar-month invoice cadence. A few requests from procurement (copied):

- They need the PO to reference the exact monthly commit number and the signed SOW.
- They asked if the SOW can include a clause stating Redwood will provide a one-week rollback plan in case the migration introduces unexpected latency.
- They also requested the first invoice be prorated to the day the contract becomes active if activation happens mid-month.

We are leaning toward approving this if we can get the SOW updated with those three items. PI: we can sign by Dec 2 if you can deliver the updated SOW and the updated rate matrix by Mon 11/23 EOD.

—Emma

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@clarityai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@clarityai.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: hosted API commit advance and throttle migration plan

Emma / team —

Appreciate the clarity and the timeline. We can deliver the updated SOW and rate matrix by EOD Mon 11/23. Action items on our side:

- Marissa to add a rollback clause (one-week rollback with clear SLA targets) and explicit monthly commit numbers into the SOW.
- Karthik to itemize the migration ops checklist and monitoring playbook in an appendix.
- Finance to prepare a prorated-first-invoice template for mid-month activation and confirm calendar-month invoicing.

Marissa — can you confirm the SRE availability for the week of Dec 6 and attach the staffed roster to the SOW?

If we hit the 11/23 deadline, next steps are: procurement raises PO referencing CLAR-2026-09 -> DocuSign link -> target sign by 12/02 -> schedule migration week of Dec 6.

Thanks all — I’ll push the updated docs first thing Monday morning and share a DocuSign draft link once procurement confirms PO format.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: (updated SOW and rate matrix pending)
